meta.name: Aescape
meta.description: Measured design DNA of www.aescape.com, captured as a read-only reference baseline. Values are observed computed values, not authored source tokens. The site is Framer-generated, so this DNA is a reconstruction from rendered output.
meta.capture_method: web-clone v1.6.0 — recon-site / route-crawl / interaction-probe / network-capture at 1440, 768, 390 px

confidence.color: high — read from CSS custom properties
confidence.typography: high — read from Framer typography token sets
confidence.spacing: low — Framer emits per-element absolute values, no spacing scale exists to extract
confidence.layout: medium — inferred from rendered geometry, not from a declared grid
confidence.motion: low — Framer runtime motion is not introspectable from computed styles

color.palette_type: warm neutral base with a lavender primary and three saturated accents

primary.role: primary lavender; paired with #8e8acd and #b0addc as a 3-step ramp

secondary.role: near-black; the dominant dark band surface, confirmed visually at 1440px

_token_not_dominant.role: deep green — present as a declared token but not observed as a major surface on the homepage; scope unverified

neutral.usage: #ede9e0 is the dominant page ground (warm bone), not #fff; #fff is reserved for cards/inverted type

color.contrast_strategy: alternating full-bleed bands: warm bone (#ede9e0), white, and near-black. Confirmed visually — the page reads as a light/dark band rhythm, with the lavender ramp carrying accent duty inside dark bands and accents used as small fills rather than large areas.

responsive_behaviour.pattern: size decreases and weight increases together across the breakpoint; lost size is compensated with weight rather than allowed to lose emphasis
responsive_behaviour.method: direct DOM inspection at all three widths (not extractor output)

typography.scale_notes: Observed steps 14 / 16 / 23 / 29 / 36 / 48 px. Ratio between steps is ~1.24-1.28, close to a major-third scale but not exactly regular — consistent with values set by hand in a visual editor rather than generated from a ratio. Values captured at 1440px; Framer emits per-breakpoint overrides that were not enumerated.
typography.font_style_notes: Tight negative tracking (-0.02 to -0.04em) across the whole scale. Headings run at weight 350 — light, large, and tight, which is the dominant typographic signature. OpenType features enabled: blwf, cv03, cv04, cv09, cv11.
typography.LICENSING: ABC Repro (ABC Dinamo) and Nyght Serif are commercial licensed faces. They were NOT downloaded and must NOT be reused. Substitute a licensed or open face when reconstructing. Inter is the only open face present.

spacing.content_density: low — long vertical page with generous band padding
spacing._note: No spacing scale could be extracted. Framer positions elements with absolute per-element values and hashed class names; there is no spacing token set in the CSS. Any spacing system for the rebuild has to be authored, not recovered.

layout.grid_system: no declared grid; flex-based Framer stacks
layout.breakpoints: measured at 1440 / 768 / 390; Framer's own breakpoints not enumerated from source
layout.alignment_tendency: centered content column inside full-bleed colored bands

motion.scroll_behaviour: native scroll; no smooth-scroll hijack library detected
motion.notes: See MOTION_MAP.md. Framer's motion is driven by its runtime and is not recoverable from computed styles; durations and easings below are not measured and must not be treated as fact.

media._note: No media files were downloaded. Dimensions only.
